sources.supports: LangGraph is a low-level stateful orchestration runtime; its official introduction includes a minimal graph and recommends choosing the appropriate higher-level layer.
Interrupts use persisted state and a thread_id; resume values use Command. Side effects before an interrupt may be replayed.
Checkpointers scope state by thread; stores hold cross-thread data. In-memory examples are distinct from durable production persistence.
